formal_project_title: AI-Based Clinical Decision Support System for Early Identification of Glioblastoma Multiforme

deployment_policy.recommended_api: Oracle Cloud Always Free Ampere A1 VM + Docker
deployment_policy.recommended_object_storage: Oracle Always Free persistent block volume for initial demo runtime

known_release_gates: Oracle linux/arm64 Docker preflight must pass before the Always Free A1 VM is created.
Five frozen classifier checkpoints must be present before 2D runtime is READY.
Durable cloud MRI object storage must be enabled/validated before claiming persistent hosted study storage.
External/manual clinical validation remains outside the current project evidence.
